sources.title: 総合振興計画基本計画（令和3年度～令和12年度）
sources.review_boundary: The canonical city landing for the current basic plan is verified. Policy indicators, target definitions, denominators, revisions, and page-level evidence remain unreviewed and must not be inferred from the landing page alone.

sources.title: 総合振興計画実施計画（令和8年度～令和12年度）
sources.review_boundary: The current five-year implementation plan and its annual-review policy are verified. Individual projects, departments, targets, annual revisions, costs, and fiscal links require record-level evidence review.

sources.title: 総合振興計画基本計画の令和6年度の実施状況について
sources.review_boundary: The official fiscal 2024 PDCA progress publication for the current 2021–2030 basic plan is verified. It reflects the prior 2021–2025 implementation-plan cycle and must not be relabeled as a result of the 2026–2030 implementation plan.

sources.title: 令和8年度当初予算
sources.review_boundary: The official landing confirms that the fiscal 2026 initial budget was enacted on March 12, 2026. General, special, water, hospital, sewer, supplementary, execution, and project-financing records remain separate evidence states.

sources.title: 令和6年度決算
sources.review_boundary: The fiscal 2024 settlement landing, general-account overview, administrative report, and continuing-expenditure settlement route are verified. Account-level values, audit findings, execution, and policy outcomes remain separate until record-level review.

quality_boundary: This inventory verifies the canonical current basic plan, the current 2026–2030 implementation plan, the fiscal 2024 PDCA progress route, the enacted fiscal 2026 initial budget, and the fiscal 2024 settlement route. It does not promote plan indicators, progress judgments, projects, budget values, settlement values, or outcomes to Reviewed, linked, comparable, causal, or policy-achievement status, and it keeps the 2024 progress report version-separated from the new 2026–2030 implementation plan.
next_action: Review the current basic-plan indicators and 2026–2030 implementation projects at page-level evidence depth, preserve the prior implementation-cycle boundary for fiscal 2024 progress, and map fiscal 2026 budget and fiscal 2024 settlement records without inferring causal attribution or cross-city comparability.
